body:
Metrics Credit Partners has suspended redemptions from its $6 billion unlisted wholesale fund, as valuation concerns that led to a dispute with auditors create significant uncertainties for the lending giant.

The wholesale fund underpins several of Metrics’ strategies, feeding into its ASX-listed Master Income Trust, which was suspended from trade on Monday after revealing material differences in its audited accounts.
